name: Mary's Pizza
tagline: Home-style cooking in Gorham, NH since 1947.
seo_title: Mary's Pizza | Family Pizzeria in Gorham, NH Since 1947
seo_desc: Mary's Pizza, 9 Cascade Flats, Gorham NH. Fresh dough pizza and homemade pasta since 1947, voted Best Pizza in NH by WMUR viewers. Full menu with prices. Call (603) 752-6150.

menu.note: Everyday, plus a deal on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

items.name: Everyday Lunch Special
items.desc: 1 Large Cheese Pizza

items.name: Every Tuesday
items.desc: 1 Large 1-Topping Pizza, 4 Breadsticks & a 2 liter of Soda

items.name: Every Thursday
items.desc: 2 Large 3-Topping Pizzas

menu.note: Choose your crust: Thin (crispy), Regular (original), Pan (thick) or Gluten-Free (small only). Thin or regular is cooked on a screen for a soft center. Roman Pizza is thin and crispy, with a low, crunchy crust and generous toppings. Prices shown are Small / Large, then Pan or Gluten-Free Small / Large.
